topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I can't believe this is happening. Someone has accused me of plagiarism. I've always been careful with my work, double-checking everything to make sure I cite my sources properly. It feels like a misunderstanding, a big one. I need to go through my paper again, line by line, to see where things might have gone wrong. I also need to figure out how to approach this. It’s not just about my grade; it’s about my integrity. I never intended to take someone else’s work as my own. Now, I have to prove that.
